2607.22165.title: DBA-Bench: A Production-Fidelity Benchmark for LLM-Based Database Operations Agents
2607.22165.paper_summary: LLM-based database agents show promise, but differing task scopes, testbeds, and metrics hinder comparison. We identify four gaps between evaluation and production operations: live-environment fidelity (multi-turn read-write interaction with a running database); observation-space scale and complexity (causal diagnosis across thousands of time series, business logs, and concurrent activity); solution-space openness (multiple remediations with different operational trade-offs); and scenario complexity and coverage (faults cascading across internal mechanisms and operational domains). We present DBA-Bench, a benchmark addressing these gaps through production fidelity, outcome-first evaluation, and controlled scenario reproducibility. It uses instrumented PostgreSQL environments with active workloads, persistent state, and multi-source observations; defines success by measurable recovery or fault elimination under safety constraints; and restores snapshots with scenario-specific checks before each run. The benchmark contains 106 scenarios across seven task domains, with two public difficulty labels based on reference-path diagnostic depth and environmental complexity. We evaluate nine baseline groups, including six foundation-model systems, two GPT-5.5-backed database agents, and a Human DBA reference. Across 848 automated runs, Diagnosis, Outcome, and Safe Pass rates are 32.7%, 19.6%, and 12.4%; the best automated baseline reaches 17.9% Safe Pass versus 93.4% for the Human DBA reference. Automated Safe Pass falls from 19.6% on Easy scenarios to 7.6% on Hard scenarios, underscoring the difficulty of safe end-to-end remediation.
2607.22165.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基礎的資料庫代理顯示出潛力，但不同的任務範疇、測試平台和指標阻礙了比較。我們確定了評估和生產操作之間的四個差距：實時環境的真實度（與運行中的資料庫進行多輪讀寫互動）；觀察空間的規模和複雜性（在數千個時間序列、商業日誌和並行活動中進行因果診斷）；解決方案空間的開放性（多種補救措施具有不同的操作權衡）；以及場景的複雜性和覆蓋範圍（故障在內部機制和操作領域中級聯）。我們提出 DBA-Bench，一個通過生產真實度、結果優先評估和受控場景重現來解決這些差距的基準。它使用帶有主動工作負載的儀表化 PostgreSQL 環境、持久狀態和多來源觀察；在安全約束下，通過可測量的恢復或故障消除來定義成功；並在每次運行之前恢復具有場景特定檢查的快照。該基準包含跨七個任務領域的 106 個場景，並根據參考路徑診斷深度和環境複雜性設置兩個公共難度標籤。我們評估了九個基準組，包括六個基礎模型系統、兩個基於 GPT-5.5 的資料庫代理和一個人類 DBA 參考。在 848 次自動運行中，診斷、結果和安全通過率分別為 32.7%、19.6% 和 12.4%；最佳自動基準達到 17.9% 的安全通過率，而人類 DBA 參考則為 93.4%。自動安全通過率從簡單場景的 19.6% 降至困難場景的 7.6%，突顯了安全端到端補救的難度。
